analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited delivered a resilient performance in Q1 FY27 despite a challenging operating environment marked by raw material inflation and geopolitical tensions in West Asia. The company achieved a revenue of ₹532 crore, representing a 35% year-on-year growth, and a PAT of ₹47 crore. Management expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and the resolution of raw material constraints. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial results presentation, highlighting significant YoY growth in revenue and profit after tax driven by capacity utilization and integrated operations. Management emphasized the positive industry demand outlook supported by favourable monsoons, higher MSP, and government subsidies under the Nutrient-Based Subsidy framework.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover over the previous year.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: The company hopes to achieve its target for this year, which is around 25% of last year's revenue.
guidance.quote: We hope that we will be able to achieve our target for this year, which comes to around 25% of last year's revenue.

guidance.claim: The management expects growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current financial year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: The company projects an increase in top-line revenue of around Rs. 500 crore from expanded capacity.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a top line increase of around Rs. 500 crore.

guidance.claim: Management expects overall revenue growth of 35% to 40% in FY27, including both import and manufacturing segments.
guidance.quote: Yes, including the import and manufacturing we expect 40% growth should not be a big issue.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates trading revenue of approximately Rs. 1,000 crore for FY27 based on market demand.
guidance.quote: For FY27, based on market demand, we expect to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, which would translate into approximately Rs.1,000 crore of revenue.

guidance.claim: Growth in manufacturing for FY27 is expected to be in the range of 25% based on reasonable capacity utilization.
guidance.quote: And based on the capacity utilization on a reasonable level, the growth in the manufacturing will be in the range of 25%.

demand_outlook.claim: Rainfall improvement in early July led to a rapid recovery in sowing progress and accelerated fertilizer offtake.
demand_outlook.quote: However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and continued government support through the NBS framework are expected to support fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving in monsoon conditions, higher MSP and continued government support through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are expected to support the fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth backed by strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher minimum support prices, and government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy framework create a favourable operating environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP & continued government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are creating a favourable operating environment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that comfortable domestic stock levels and a favourable monsoon forecast make the Kharif season demand environment constructive for the industry.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops approached maturity.
demand_outlook.quote: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops such as wheat and mustard approached maturity consistent with typical fertilizer application cycles.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure as essential food and fertilizer consumption remains non-negotiable.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.

demand_outlook.claim: Water levels in major reservoirs, rivers, and borewells are higher, leading management to expect no stress on the agriculture sector or fertilizer demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Also, water levels in major reservoirs, rivers, and borewells are higher compared to earlier periods in the country. Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is currently evaluating capacity expansion opportunities that have not yet been approved or disclosed.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities. Since these have not yet been approved or disclosed through the statutory channels, we are not in a position to share details at this stage.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its NPK-DAP capacity by 165,000 MT, bringing the total capacity to 495,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's green ammonia capacity under the agreement will start in FY29.
capex_expansion.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar include NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: NPK/DAP capacity was enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA alongside an existing SSP capacity of 120,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with a sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capex_expansion.claim: The new capacity expansion has already commenced production and is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.
capex_expansion.quote: As our Managing Director mentioned, our new expansion has already commenced production and is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7% to 8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company has been able to pass on approximately 25% to 30% of the increase in input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: The sequential decline in PAT margin was largely due to a sharp rise in finance costs and depreciation following the commissioning of the new capacity.
margins_costs.quote: It is largely a function of the sharp rise in finance costs and depreciation following the commissioning of the new capacity.

margins_costs.claim: Inventory carried forward from the previous quarter at lower costs contributed to higher EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory carried forward from the previous quarter at lower costs did contribute to the higher EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Global input costs tightened towards the latter part of the quarter due to supply-side constraints and higher freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Ammonia and sulphur prices moved up sequentially during the quarter, creating higher cost pressure.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, ammonia prices moved up sequentially during the quarter. Sulphur prices also firmed up towards March. This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability is expected to come down slightly during FY27 as the company absorbs some increased input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, of course, we will absorb to some extent and as a result, our profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Management notes that margins will be under pressure and FY26 levels may not be fully sustainable.
margins_costs.quote: As mentioned earlier, margins will be under pressure, and the levels achieved in FY26 may not be fully sustainable.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration has been a key contributor to the company's EBITDA margins being higher than peers.
margins_costs.quote: Backward integration has been a key contributor, which is why our EBITDA margins are higher than peers.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved 43% capacity utilization of the NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's total capacity potential can generate more than ₹3,000 crore in revenue at peak utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: Based on the capacity and the pricing I have mentioned, the total revenue potential can be more than ₹3,000 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's sales volume for NPK-DAP was 53,500 MT and for SSP was 36,300 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: Total installed capacity stands at 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
Fertilizer production reached 94,103 MT for the quarter driven by peak Rabi season demand.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Certain NPK/DAP and SSP units operated above 100% capacity during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Maintained healthy utilization across NPK/DAP and SSP plants, with certain units operating above 100% capacity, reflecting strong demand and efficient plant operations

orders_capacity.claim: Total annual fertilizer production reached 397,263 MT for FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: Trading volumes for the year were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The rock phosphate beneficiation capacity is around 200,000 tons with a current utilization range of 50% to 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: The beneficiation capacity is around 200,000 tons, and current utilization is in the range of 50% to 75%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split to enhance market liquidity and improve affordability.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: The company collected more than ₹700 crore in receivables.
capital_allocation.quote: Collection is more than Rs. 700 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Management's strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars including disciplined capital allocation.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

capital_allocation.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through internal accruals and term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

risks_headwinds.claim: The first quarter witnessed a challenging operating environment driven by global supply-side disruptions, elevated raw material prices, and geopolitical uncertainties.
risks_headwinds.quote: The 1st Quarter witnessed a challenging operating environment for the phosphatic supplier industry, primarily driven by global supply-side disruptions, elevated raw material prices, and geopolitical uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia introduced considerable uncertainty across global fertilizer supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced raw material availability issues during the first quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The primary challenge during the first quarter was the availability of raw materials.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sulphur prices rose significantly from April to June and July due to issues related to the Strait of Hormuz.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July. The issues related to the Strait of Hormuz have significantly impacted sulphur prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for stakeholders.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for our stakeholders.
